# AJ Shine Detailing

> Ceramic coating and full detailing for Doreen and Mernda locals. Book the car in with us here in Doreen, and the coating keeps it looking like this for years, not weeks.

Car Detailing & Ceramic Coating in Doreen, Mernda and surrounding northern suburbs.

## Services

- Full detail, inside and out: From $350. The lot, in one go. This is the one most people book. Sedans and hatches. SUVs, 4WDs and utes are more, there is simply more car. Quoted after I look at it.
- Ceramic coating: From $750. A hard protective layer bonded to the paint. Dirt and water sheet straight off, washing gets easier, and the colour keeps its depth for years instead of months. CarPro CQuartz UK 3.0, 2+ years, and longer if you look after it. Includes decontamination and paint correction. Scratched or older paint is quoted after I look at it, I would rather see the car than guess.
- General clean: From $80. The regular one. Keeps a car that gets looked after looking like it. Small cars from $80, SUVs and utes from $110. The regular maintenance clean, not a full detail.
- Interior detail: From $220. Everything you actually touch, done the slow way. Steam cleaned seats and carpets. Price moves with how much has gone on in there, kids, dogs and tradies all cost more, and I would rather see it than guess.
- Paint decontamination and clay bar: From $180. What a wash leaves behind. Do the bag test, if it feels gritty, it needs this. Usually done as part of a full detail or before a coating. On its own for paint that feels gritty but does not need correcting.
- Pre-sale detail: From $350. Selling it? A proper detail is the cheapest thing you can do to the price. Same work as a full detail, finished for photos. Cheapest money you will spend on the asking price.
